messages.subject: Navbar working
parts:
It took quite a bit of help from Joe but I got a bootstrap navbar working in my app. To see it in action:

http://vnijs.rady.ucsd.edu:3838/marketing/

To implement ... in ui.R you would need:

getTool <- function(inputId) {
  tagList(
    singleton(tags$head(tags$script(src = "js/navbar.js"))),
    tags$html(includeHTML('www/navbar.html'))
  )
}

shinyUI( ....

...

    sidebarPanel(

         getTool("tool"),
